project: CareLoop - Abu Dhabi Closed-Loop Screening-to-Care Platform

syntheticDataNotice.statement: All patient records and clinical identifiers in CareLoop are synthetic, generated deterministically by our internal seed script with a fixed random seed (seed = 42). They contain zero real personal health information (PHI).

sources.title: US cluster RCT
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Baseline follow-up rate without navigation vs boosted completion when multi-channel navigator intervention triggers (+8.5% lift)
sources.limitation: Primary care network cohort within US healthcare safety net; 120-day follow-up endpoint.

sources.title: Tanzania RCT
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Validates why single SMS reminders alone have ~24% acknowledgement rate and produce no statistically meaningful lift (0.0% lift) without active multi-tiered escalation
sources.limitation: Rural East African low-resource setting evaluating standalone automated SMS in isolation without human navigator escalation.

sources.title: Cameroon RCT
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Calibrates optimistic upper-bound telephone navigation lift (+19.5% lift) in high-barrier settings
sources.limitation: Conducted in low-resource setting where baseline standard of care follow-up was 6.1%.

sources.title: Meta-analysis, PLOS ONE
sources.population: 28 studies (11 RCTs, 17 observational), cervical abnormal-screen follow-up
sources.empiricalFinding: multicomponent OR 3.01 (95% CI 2.03-4.46) vs single 1.56 (95% CI 1.14-2.14)
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Parameterizes the multi-tier escalation ladder efficacy multiplier in CareLoop simulation engine
sources.limitation: Heterogeneity in study designs, intervention durations, and definitions of abnormal screening results across pooled international studies.

sources.title: International FIT survey
sources.empiricalFinding: mean 79% colonoscopy within 6 months, range 39-100%; organised 81% vs opportunistic 57%
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Establishes empirical baselines: opportunistic screening (57.0%) and organized registry screening (79.0%)
sources.limitation: Endoscopy facility availability, waitlists, and registry enforcement vary widely between surveyed programmes.

sources.title: Abu Dhabi 2015-16
sources.citation: Almansoori et al., BMC Cancer 2021 (cited second-hand)
sources.population: adult Emiratis in ambulatory healthcare centres
sources.empiricalFinding: 23.5% FOBT uptake, 13.5% follow-up colonoscopy among FOBT-positive
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Historical unmanaged baseline (13.5%) highlighting follow-up drop-off in the absence of active digital closed-loop tracking
sources.limitation: Historical 2015-2016 audit cited second-hand from Almansoori et al., BMC Cancer 2021; restricted to adult Emiratis in ambulatory healthcare centres; predates modern Malaffi HIE integration.

assumptions.name: Language Alignment Uplift
assumptions.value: 18% penalty if notification language mismatches patient preferred language
assumptions.rationale: Empirical health communication literature indicates comprehension drop-offs when health alerts are delivered in a secondary language.

assumptions.name: Arabic RTL Comprehension Gain
assumptions.value: 15% increase in understanding confirmation when Arabic text is properly formatted with RTL layout
assumptions.rationale: User interface accessibility standard: inverted or broken bidirectional text impairs medical instruction comprehension.

assumptions.name: Critical Urgency Fast-Track
assumptions.value: Immediate escalation bypasses routine 72h waiting window
assumptions.rationale: High-acuity red flag findings require direct emergency clinical triage rather than asynchronous outreach steps.

assumptions.name: UAE Business Calendar Working Days
assumptions.value: Monday through Friday treated as working days; Saturday and Sunday excluded from SLA countdowns
assumptions.rationale: Aligned with the UAE Federal and Abu Dhabi official working week adopted in January 2022.

rules.name: Colorectal Screening Follow-up (Positive FIT)
rules.sourceRef: UAE National Guidelines for Colorectal Cancer Screening (Positive FIT -> Colonoscopy <= 31 working days)

rules.name: Breast Cancer Screening Follow-up
rules.sourceRef: Abu Dhabi Department of Health Breast Cancer Screening Standard (Results communicated <= 15 working days)

rules.name: WHO Cervical Cancer Early Diagnosis & Treatment
rules.sourceRef: WHO Global Strategy for Cervical Cancer Elimination: 90% of women with identified cervical disease treated within 30 working days

rules.name: WHO Global Breast Cancer Initiative (GBCI)
rules.sourceRef: WHO Global Breast Cancer Initiative: Complete diagnostic resolution within 60 calendar days (~42 working days)

rules.name: Ontario FIT-Positive Colonoscopy Pathway
rules.sourceRef: Cancer Care Ontario ColonCancerCheck Standard: colonoscopy within 8 weeks (40 working days)

rules.name: Community Colorectal Screening Follow-up
rules.sourceRef: Primary Health Network Low-Resource Protocol: confirmatory evaluation within 45 working days

rules.name: Community Cervical & Breast Follow-up
rules.sourceRef: Community Cervical / Breast Navigation Standard: diagnostic evaluation within 30 working days
